comment: No source is published. Input 0 is MIX CV IN, and inputs 1 to 24 run in threes down each channel strip: signal in, level CV, pan CV. Outputs 0 and 1 are OUT L and OUT R, outputs 2 to 9 are the eight channel outputs left to right. Params: 0 is MIX LEVEL, 1 to 8 the channel levels (0 to 1, default 0), 9 to 16 the pans (-1 to +1, default 0), 17 to 24 the mutes. Unsettled: each channel is multiplied by two separately clamped copies of its level CV, which would make the response square-law between 0V and 10V rather than linear; the endpoints are certain, the middle is not, so no line claims a law. The pan CV forms a pair of gains from the voltage scaled by 0.2 and multiplies the knob's pair by it, and the two sides are not symmetric about any voltage; only the fact that a voltage of exactly 0V leaves the knob untouched is stated.
